items.question: Is this AI resume builder really free?
items.answer: Yes! You can create, edit, and preview your resume completely free. We offer premium plans for advanced features like unlimited PDF downloads and additional templates, but you can build a professional resume without paying anything.

items.question: What is an ATS and why does it matter?
items.answer: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is software used by 99% of Fortune 500 companies to scan and filter resumes. Our AI ensures your resume is ATS-optimized with the right keywords, formatting, and structure to pass these automated screenings.

items.question: How does the AI help write my resume?
items.answer: Our AI analyzes your job title and experience to generate professional bullet points, summaries, and skill suggestions. It uses industry-specific keywords and achievement-focused language that recruiters look for.

items.question: Do I need to sign up to use the builder?
items.answer: No signup required to start building! You can create your entire resume first. Only sign up when you want to save your progress or download. This lets you try everything risk-free.

items.question: Can I download my resume as a PDF?
items.answer: Yes! Export your resume as a pixel-perfect PDF that looks exactly like the preview. PDFs are optimized for both digital applications and printing on standard letter/A4 paper.

items.question: How long does it take to create a resume?
items.answer: Most users create a professional resume in under 10 minutes. Our AI suggestions and pre-written content speed up the process significantly compared to starting from scratch.

whatIsAts.question: What is an ATS (Applicant Tracking System)?
whatIsAts.answer: An ATS is software used by employers to collect, scan, and rank job applications. It filters resumes based on keywords, formatting, and relevance before a recruiter ever sees them. Over 98% of Fortune 500 companies use an ATS.

whyFail.question: Why do resumes fail ATS screening?
whyFail.answer: Common reasons include complex formatting (tables, columns, graphics), missing keywords from the job description, non-standard section headings, incompatible file formats, and information placed in headers or footers that ATS can't read.

bestFormat.question: What's the best resume format for ATS?
bestFormat.answer: A clean, single-column layout with standard section headings works best. Use simple formatting, standard fonts, and avoid graphics or tables. PDF and DOCX are the most universally accepted file formats.

keywords.question: How do I find the right keywords for my resume?
keywords.answer: Read the job description carefully and identify repeated skills, qualifications, and terminology. Include these keywords naturally throughout your resume, especially in your summary, skills section, and work experience descriptions.

twoColumn.question: Can I use a two-column resume with ATS?
twoColumn.answer: Two-column layouts can cause parsing issues with many ATS systems. The software may read across columns instead of down them, jumbling your information. A single-column layout is the safest choice for ATS compatibility.

jobTitle.question: Should I match the exact job title in my resume?
jobTitle.answer: Yes, if your actual title is similar. Including the exact job title from the posting in your resume (where truthful) significantly improves ATS matching. You can include it in your summary or as a target role.

1.title: Create Your Account
1.description: Click the Get Started button on the homepage or the Sign Up link in the navigation bar. You can register instantly with your Google, GitHub, or LinkedIn account — no password needed. Prefer email? Enter your name, email, and choose a password.
1.tip: Signing in with Google or LinkedIn is fastest — your name and email are filled in automatically.

2.title: Verify Your Email
2.description: If you registered with email, check your inbox for a message from Best AI Resume. Enter the 6-digit verification code on the verification page. The code expires in 10 minutes — if it expires, click 'Resend Code' to get a new one.
2.tip: Check your spam or junk folder if you don't see the email within a minute.

3.title: You're In
3.description: After verification, you'll be taken to the onboarding screen where you choose how to build your first resume. Your account automatically saves every change you make, so you'll never lose your work — even if you close the browser.

1.q: Do I need a credit card to sign up?
1.a: No. You can create an account and build your resume completely free. A credit card is only required when you choose a paid plan.

2.q: What if I don't receive the verification code?
2.a: Check your spam/junk folder first. If it's not there, click 'Resend Code' on the verification page. If you still don't receive it, try signing up with Google or LinkedIn instead.

3.q: Can I use the same account on multiple devices?
3.a: Yes. Your account and all your resumes are stored in the cloud. Log in from any device and pick up right where you left off.

1.title: Choose Your Method
1.description: On the onboarding page, you'll see four options: AI Generation (recommended for most users), Upload Resume (parse an existing PDF), Import from LinkedIn (pull your profile data), or Start from Scratch (blank template). Each option leads you through a short setup flow before opening the builder.
1.tip: AI Generation is the fastest way to get a complete, professional resume — you can always edit it afterward.

2.title: Let AI Do the Work
2.description: If you chose AI Generation, enter your full name, the job title you're applying for, and your experience level (entry, mid, or senior). Click Generate and our AI will create a complete resume with a professional summary, work experience, education, and skills sections — all tailored to your target role.

3.title: Pick a Template
3.description: After generation, browse our gallery of 16+ templates. Templates are organized into categories: Professional, Creative, Minimal, and ATS-Friendly. Click any template to preview it with your data. Switch between templates anytime without losing your content.
3.tip: You can change your template at any time from the builder — your content stays the same, only the design changes.

4.title: Edit & Customize
4.description: The builder has tabbed sections on the left (Personal Info, Experience, Education, Skills, etc.) and a live preview on the right. Edit any field and see changes reflected instantly. You can reorder sections, add custom sections, adjust font sizes, and change accent colors to match your style.

2.q: Does the AI generation work in all languages?

3.q: Can I import my LinkedIn profile?

howATS.title: How Applicant Tracking Systems Screen Your Resume
howATS.intro: Understanding the ATS pipeline helps you see why formatting matters more than most candidates realize. Here is what happens in the seconds after you click Apply.

step1.title: Your resume file is received and converted
step1.description: The ATS receives your PDF or DOCX file and runs it through a text extraction engine. It attempts to convert the document into structured data — separating your name, contact info, work history, education, and skills into discrete fields. If the file uses tables, columns, or images, this extraction step produces garbled or missing data.

step2.title: Content is parsed, mapped, and scored
step2.description: Once extracted, the ATS maps your content against the job description. It looks for keyword matches in your skills, job titles, and experience descriptions. Systems like Workday and Greenhouse assign a relevancy score based on how closely your resume matches the role's requirements. A poorly parsed resume scores low even if you have every qualification.

step3.title: Recruiters review ranked candidates
step3.description: Recruiters typically review the top 10-20 ranked resumes for each position. If your formatting caused parsing errors, you may rank below less-qualified candidates whose resumes parsed correctly. Our ATS-friendly templates ensure your qualifications are accurately represented in the ranking.

howATS.warning: Important: ATS compatibility is necessary but not sufficient. You still need to tailor your resume keywords to each job description. Use our ATS Checker tool to test your resume against specific job postings after choosing a template.

whatMakes.title: What Makes a Resume Template ATS-Friendly?
whatMakes.p1: An ATS-friendly resume template is designed so that Applicant Tracking Systems — the software employers use to collect, sort, and rank job applications — can accurately read every section of your resume. When an ATS fails to parse your resume, your name, experience, and skills may not reach the recruiter's screen at all. According to a 2023 Harvard Business School study, over 75% of resumes are rejected by ATS before a human reviews them.
whatMakes.p2: The most common reason resumes fail ATS parsing is formatting. Tables, multi-column layouts, text boxes, custom fonts, and embedded graphics all cause parsing errors. An ATS reads your resume as a stream of text from top to bottom. If that stream is interrupted by complex formatting, the system misassigns your data — putting your job title where your company name should be, or dropping your skills section entirely.
whatMakes.p3: Our 16 resume templates are designed from the ground up with ATS compatibility as the primary requirement. They use standard section headers, single-column layouts, web-safe fonts, and clean HTML-to-PDF rendering. Every template has been tested against the five most-used ATS platforms: Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, and Taleo. The result is a resume that looks professional to recruiters and parses perfectly for machines.

mistakes.title: 5 Formatting Mistakes That Get Resumes Rejected by ATS
mistakes.intro: Even strong candidates get filtered out when their resume formatting confuses the ATS parser. Here are the five most common mistakes we see — and that our templates eliminate automatically.

1.title: Using tables or multi-column layouts
1.description: ATS reads text in a single stream. Tables and columns cause it to merge unrelated content — your phone number might end up in your job title field.

2.title: Embedding contact info in headers or footers
2.description: Many ATS platforms skip document headers and footers entirely. If your name, email, or phone number is only in the header, it disappears from your parsed profile.

3.title: Using creative section labels
3.description: Labels like "Where I've Been" instead of "Experience" or "My Toolbox" instead of "Skills" cause ATS to skip the entire section. Stick to standard labels.

4.title: Saving as image-based PDF or using non-standard fonts
4.description: If text can't be selected in your PDF, ATS can't read it. Scanned documents, design-tool exports, and uncommon fonts all produce unreadable files.

5.title: Adding graphics, icons, or skill bars
5.description: Progress bars, star ratings, and icons for contact info are invisible to ATS. A "4 out of 5 stars" skill rating becomes blank text that scores zero.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About ATS-Friendly Templates

1.q: What does ATS-friendly mean for a resume template?
1.a: An ATS-friendly template is designed so Applicant Tracking Systems can accurately extract your name, contact info, work history, education, and skills. It avoids tables, multi-column layouts, embedded images, and custom fonts that cause parsing failures. All 16 templates on this page are tested against Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, and Taleo.

2.q: Can a creative or modern resume still be ATS-compatible?
2.a: Yes. ATS compatibility depends on the underlying structure, not the visual design. A resume can use color accents, custom spacing, and stylish typography while still maintaining a single-column, text-selectable layout that ATS reads correctly. Our modern and creative templates achieve this balance — they look distinctive to recruiters while parsing perfectly for machines.

3.q: Should I submit my resume as PDF or DOCX for ATS?
3.a: PDF is generally the safest choice in 2026. Modern ATS platforms (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever) parse well-structured PDFs reliably. DOCX can introduce formatting inconsistencies across different Word versions. Our builder exports text-selectable PDFs optimized for ATS parsing — we recommend using PDF unless the job posting explicitly requests DOCX.

4.q: How do I know if my resume passes ATS screening?
4.a: Use our free ATS Checker tool to upload your resume and see how an ATS reads it. The tool shows you which fields were correctly parsed, which keywords matched the job description, and where parsing errors occurred. You can test as many times as you need before submitting your application.

5.q: Do I need a different template for each job application?
5.a: No — one ATS-friendly template works for all applications. What you should change between applications is the content: tailor your skills section, professional summary, and achievement bullets to match each job description's keywords. The template structure stays the same; the keywords change.
